decisions.title: Edition separation and implementation scope
decisions.requiredEvidence: User-authorized early administrative edition; no clinical roadmap/gate completion inferred.

decisions.title: Doctor commercial terms and expiry/downgrade access
decisions.requiredEvidence: Owner-approved Doctor price/currency/interval/trial/quotas/renewal/grace/refund/cancellation and record-access policy; no Shop defaults.

decisions.title: Payment route, merchant eligibility and actual reconciliation
decisions.requiredEvidence: Approved Doctor provider/manual route, merchant/entity eligibility, credentials custody and actual test/acceptance evidence.

decisions.title: Qualified SaaS tax-document applicability
decisions.requiredEvidence: Qualified current review for the actual entity, SaaS business model and sale jurisdictions; no assumption from Shop or patient services.

decisions.title: Qualified privacy/real-data and rights policy
decisions.requiredEvidence: Controller/processor, purpose/basis, minors/caregivers, retention/holds, export/erasure, complaints and explicit administrative real-user approval.

decisions.title: Hosting and data-flow approval
decisions.requiredEvidence: Exact regions/providers/subprocessors/transfers, support access and verified contracts; user manages Doctor connections.

decisions.title: Recovery objectives and custody
decisions.requiredEvidence: Approved RPO/RTO, encrypted backup scope/custody/retention, restore rights and actual hosted recovery evidence.

decisions.title: Independent financial and security acceptance
decisions.requiredEvidence: Exact-candidate independent reviews, retests and resolution of critical/high launch blockers; no self-certification.

decisions.title: Operational limits and supervised administrative acceptance
decisions.requiredEvidence: Approved workload thresholds, provider costs/quotas, support and incident owners, limited population/consent/stop criteria and actual user acceptance.

decisions.title: Exact-candidate public release and live activation
decisions.requiredEvidence: Owner go/no-go, deployment/recovery evidence, product release registration/baseline and approved public destinations; no main promotion authorized.

acceptance.assertion: Keep all nine original plans, IDs, gates and completion states unchanged; the early administrative edition has its own task and acceptance IDs.
Limit the edition to appointments, private administrative queue, staff/location permissions and basic patient administration plus the minimum SaaS/privacy/recovery controls.
Map every extracted M6/M7 requirement and changed dependency; exclude patient charges and clinical/mobile/provider-delivery features without claiming original milestone completion.
Record unresolved accountable owner/operator decisions without invented commercial, legal, hosting, recovery or activation values.

tasks.title: Server-enforced administrative edition and safe data projections

acceptance.assertion: Default to synthetic preview; administrative candidate/live capability sets are explicit, versioned and enforced by server/database authority, never browser metadata.

Fail-close private document upload/access, clinical records, prescribing, clinical/free-text notes, imports, outbound messaging and patient charge collection for this edition; preserve historical code/data.
Use fixed administrative cancellation/reschedule reason codes while preserving attributed history; omit unsupported free-text/clinical payloads from edition projections.
Preserve fresh session, independent doctor/secretary and per-location authorization, safe queue privacy, scoped Realtime, concurrent conflict and idempotency safeguards.

tasks.title: Configurable Doctor terms, subscriptions and entitlement enforcement

acceptance.assertion: Represent Doctor-specific approved plan, price/currency/interval, trial, quotas, renewal, grace, expiry, refund and cancellation policies as versioned trusted data; missing values stay unconfigured.
Doctor is the SaaS subscriber; independently invited secretary access and patient financial operations do not become subscriptions.
Enforce current entitlements and concurrent staff/location allocation atomically and idempotently on the server, including forged plans and stale/replayed requests.
Preserve authorized historical access and privacy/export request access on subscription expiry; do not delete history or reset trials/paid periods to enforce limits.

tasks.title: SaaS quote and approved payment-route interface

acceptance.assertion: Construct exact server-side SaaS quote/intents from approved immutable terms, subscriber identity, currency and current subscription; reject browser totals and arbitrary URLs.
Keep payment route unconfigured until Doctor merchant eligibility, provider/manual-review route, credentials custody and SaaS tax-document applicability are approved.
Separate test-provider evidence from actual provider/merchant acceptance; do not create accounts, credentials, charges or callback activation.
No clinic service prices, patient charges, collections, receipts or tax-submission adapter are included.

tasks.title: Verified settlement, reconciliation and subscription lifecycle

acceptance.assertion: Only authenticated verified payment evidence or explicitly approved audited manual review may settle an exact matching intent/amount/currency/subscriber; redirects and pending/unknown state never activate paid access.
Persist duplicate/out-of-order callbacks, request replays and reconciliation under transactional locks with immutable financial history.
Implement only configured renewal/cancel/reactivate effective-date and preservation policies; reconcile unknown outcomes before retry and never invent automatic charges/refunds.
Report SaaS invoices/payments/settlements/discrepancies separately from deferred patient revenue; retain currency separation and source links.
Require exact-candidate independent financial review and actual payment/provider evidence before any paid/live-sale claim.

tasks.title: Doctor-isolated Super Admin account and plan contract

acceptance.assertion: Reuse the versioned signed administration protocol, verified manifest/binding, operator capability checks, request replay and audit mechanics with Doctor-specific capabilities and environment identity.
Do not reuse Shop RPCs, identity/session data, keys, prices, original trial/paid periods, receipts or subscription history; never import another app implementation.

Doctor account onboarding and operator grant/activation require target-owned verified identity and explicit authority; no email-match ownership, automatic email verification, impersonation or source-owned password.
Missing Doctor target binding, signing configuration, live policy or evidence returns unavailable; an operator grant is labelled separately from payment confirmation.

tasks.title: Identity-verified privacy, consent and rights operations

acceptance.assertion: Record qualified edition-specific controller/processor, purpose/lawful basis, minors/caregivers, retention/holds, complaints and real-data approval; generated copy is not legal acceptance.
Provide scoped identity-verified access/correction/export/erasure request cases, accountable decisions and append-only history; no direct bulk dump or guessed automatic deletion.
Execute only approved policy outcomes with tenant/location/session isolation, partial/refused outcomes and legal/financial holds; export authorization remains independent of paid writes.
Maintain exact browser/backend/storage/logging/support/backup provider and region/subprocessor/transfer inventory; unknown hosting approval blocks real data.

tasks.title: Supported backup, restore and recovery qualification

acceptance.assertion: Keep approved RPO/RTO, encrypted custody, retention and restore permissions explicit and unset until owner evidence exists.

Implement isolated synthetic backup/restore integrity verification for Doctor public/private/Auth data, entitlement/payment/audit/idempotency records and retained document metadata/bytes where applicable.
Treat database backup, Storage object bytes and provider/Auth/function/configuration recovery as separate scopes; a database dump alone is not whole-service recovery proof.
Measure functional disposable restoration without touching hosted data; actual hosted recovery and objective acceptance require independent operator/provider evidence.

tasks.title: Security, redacted operations, incidents and measured limits

acceptance.assertion: Exercise tenant/doctor/location, Auth/recovery, privilege, Storage/Realtime, export and administrative access boundaries with reproducible synthetic evidence and exact-head regression.
Track independent security findings and retests; unresolved critical/high launch blockers cannot be waived by code or a self-issued certificate.
Provide redacted health/reconciliation/recovery signals and incident ownership/escalation/containment runbooks; never log patient payloads, credentials or send external incident messages.
Measure synthetic workloads only against explicit approved thresholds, provider quotas/cost and support ownership; no invented capacity or hosted load claim.

tasks.title: Nonclinical UI, onboarding and subscription presentation

acceptance.assertion: Keep all visual components/templates in packages/ui and interaction controllers in packages/ux; Doctor supplies logic, authorized projections and EN/AR copy.
Present only the administrative edition with honest preview/candidate/live states and capability-aware onboarding, plan/payment/expiry status and rights access.
No clinical record/prescription, mobile app, document upload, outgoing-message, tax-compliance, security-certification or paid/live readiness claims without corresponding accepted evidence.
Keep independent marketing work separate; show no guessed domain, support destination, price/trial or provider destination.

tasks.title: Exact-candidate edition acceptance and one release aggregate

acceptance.assertion: Collect exact-head unit, SQL/RLS/concurrency, browser, real disposable provider, shared consumer, boundary/build/type/lint and release provenance evidence; distinguish failures/skips/unrun/hosted receipts.
Assemble independent financial/security, qualified legal/tax, approved hosting/recovery/real-user and actual payment/operator acceptance for this administrative candidate; no clinical gate is waived.
Prepare bounded stacked PRs and one reviewed passing aggregate into stg for the parent; original M6/M7 and the full clinical product remain uncompleted.
Keep code merge, CI deployment, hosted migrations, live activation and main promotion separate; no manual deployment, hosted mutation, credential creation, DNS/security change or home-network access.
Do not claim sale readiness or admit real users until all edition gates and exact-candidate owner go/no-go evidence are accepted.
